description: P0.2 rules distances (11e 24.32 SCOUT MOVE: end more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units). The AI's suggested Scout move uses the 8-9" band its old hard-coded 9" refused, and the Scout prompts read 8" (they said 9" for the whole of 11e). Setup by script: only P2's Kommandos and P1's Kommandos (each re-formed as a coherent 2x5 block - the fixture's 16.9" lines are not 11e-coherent) and one P1 model (Kaptin Badrukk, 40mm) stay on the board; Badrukk sits 13.25" from the P2 Kommandos' centroid toward the objective the AI first picks. P2 clicks Suggest: the card proposes BEGIN_SCOUT_MOVE (at the old 9" the AI skipped). Accept: the real ScoutPhase stages and confirms every model; the closest Kommando ends 8-9" from the enemy base to base. The step hands over to P1, who clicks their Kommandos in the list: the status line and unit card say 'must end >8" from enemies'. No ERROR in the debug log.
